decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation for heat exchangers supports the firm's strategic push toward energy recovery from wastewater and fits its automation portfolio, so the expanding firm is likely to keep developing it despite a niche market.
A web tool for weir dimensioning is cheap to maintain, serves engineering planners in the flood-control core business, and works as a lead generator, so dropping it makes little sense.
The fouling detection system is likely tied to R&D or EU-funded work on heat recovery and complements Product A, so it will probably stay on the market, though it could later be merged with A.
